rules.H_VER_UPSTREAM: R-VER-1: verifiers check toolchain archives and environment components against upstream signed checksums
rules.H_VER_BINDS_CANDIDATE: R-VER-1 / R-CON-2: an honest verifier attests exactly the candidate and the kernel tree it reproduced from the source
rules.H_REG_RECORDS_FIRST_HAND: R-REG-3 (d): the ceremony counts only first-hand verification records for exactly the candidate
rules.H_REG_UPSTREAM: R-REG-3 (a), (c'): the ceremony checks toolchain archives and environment components against upstream signatures
rules.H_REG_ENV_QUORUM: R-BENV-2: the registered image digest is established by a first-hand environment reproduction quorum
rules.H_REP_ENV_REASSEMBLE: R-BENV-4: honest reproducers re-assemble the registered environment from pinned components and refuse a mismatch
rules.H_REG_CONTENT_FIRST_HAND: R-CON-1: custodians derive kernel tree, unit map and migrations from the fetched source
rules.H_REG_OWN_REPRODUCTION: R-REG-3 (f): under OP-9 (d) custodians name their own reproduction
rules.H_REP_BY_DIGEST: R-REP-2: reproducers obtain every input by digest
rules.H_REP_FIRST_HAND: R-REP-3: reproducers confirm first-hand to the publisher
rules.H_SIGN_REPRODUCE: 05 §7 rule 2: candidate and final signers sign only the payload they rebuilt from the source
rules.H_PUB_REGISTRATION_RESTRICTORS: R-PUB-1': the publisher references a registration only when E7's restrictors hold on the statements it holds
rules.V_QUORUM: AP-6: at least q distinct reproducer keys
rules.V_CONFLICT: AP-6 / R-REP-5: a visible conflicting reproduction refuses
rules.V_REJECTED: AP-5: a held REJECTED attestation refuses
rules.V_VERIFICATION_COUNT: AP-5: at least OP-8 ACCEPTED attestations
rules.V_CANDIDATE_BINDING: AP-5 / R-CON-2: counted attestations name the registered candidate and kernel tree (not only the source)
rules.V_E7_RESTRICTORS: E7 / R-CON-3: policy-root eligibility applies AP-5's restrictors
rules.V_REVOCATION_AUTHORITY: AP-5r / R-REP-5' (CR5-B-01): restrictors are removed only under the registration authority
rules.V_FC_COMPILED_QUORUM: FC-4: compiled first-contact quorum, never read from the state the typed value selects
rules.V_FC_LINEAGE: FC-6 / FC-7: lineage from the typed value; compiled lineage under OP-13 (c)
rules.V_FC_EVALUATOR: FC-1…FC-3 / FC-8: evaluator selected through the manifest bound by the agreed first-contact code
rules.V_P1_NAMES_STATE: 24 §4.4 (CR4-B-07 option 1): a P1 proof covers only the Trust State it names
rules.V_ENV_DIVERSITY: R-BENV-5: under OP-16 (b) acceptance needs matching reproductions from two supplier classes
rules.V_OP9D_DIGEST: AP-6 under OP-9 (d): the digest equals the registered digest
rules.V_PUBLISHED: AP-7: the selected Trust State publishes the digest
rules.V_REGISTRATION_REFERENCED: AP-5: the registration is referenced by the selected Trust State
